compute_chunk_indices_evenly: compute chunk start and end indices for evenly divisible elements across distributed ranks
compute_chunk_indices_unevenly: compute chunk indices for unevenly divisible elements where some ranks get one extra element
compute_chunk_indices_single_rank: compute chunk indices for a single rank that should receive all elements
compute_chunk_indices_more_ranks_than_el: compute chunk indices when there are more ranks than elements, returning empty ranges for excess ranks
test_compute_chunk_indices: test the compute_chunk_indices function with evenly divisible, unevenly divisible, single rank, and more-ranks-than-elements scenarios
